17.question: Match List I with List II: List I (Hardware) A. Keyboard B. CPU C. Monitor List II (Function) 1. Output device to display visuals 2. Processes instructions 3. Input device for typing text
17.explanation: The keyboard is an input device for typing, the CPU processes instructions and the monitor displays output.

18.question: Match List I with List II: List I (Category) A. Application software B. Hardware (input device) C. System software (operating system) List II (Example) 1. Windows 2. Microphone 3. Paint
18.explanation: Paint is application software, a microphone is an input device and Windows is an operating system.

19.question: Match List I with List II: List I (Storage device) A. Pen drive B. RAM C. Hard disk List II (Characteristic) 1. Temporary storage 2. Portable storage 3. Permanent storage
19.explanation: A pen drive is portable, RAM is temporary and a hard disk stores data permanently.

32.question: Match List I with List II: List I (Category) A. System software B. Operating system C. Application software List II (Example) 1. Device Driver 2. Windows 3. Word Processor
32.explanation: A device driver is system software, Windows is an operating system and a word processor is application software.

52.question: Match List I with List II: List I (Shortcut) A. Ctrl + M B. F5 C. Ctrl + D List II (Action) 1. Start Slide Show 2. Duplicate Slide 3. Insert New Slide
52.explanation: Ctrl + M inserts a new slide, F5 starts the slide show and Ctrl + D duplicates a slide.

53.question: Match List I with List II: List I (View) A. Slide Sorter view B. Normal view C. Reading view List II (Used for) 1. Editing slides 2. Rearranging slides 3. Viewing in a window
53.explanation: Slide Sorter rearranges slides, Normal view is for editing and Reading view shows the show in a window.

54.question: Match List I with List II: List I (Tab) A. Design tab B. Insert tab C. Animations tab List II (Action) 1. Change Theme 2. Add Entrance Effect 3. Add Pictures
54.explanation: The Design tab changes themes, the Insert tab adds pictures and the Animations tab adds entrance effects.

70.question: Match List I with List II: List I (Term) A. Taskbar B. Icon C. Wallpaper List II (Description) 1. Small picture 2. Background image 3. Bottom bar
70.explanation: The taskbar is the bar at the bottom, an icon is a small picture and the wallpaper is the background image.

71.question: Match List I with List II: List I (Mouse action) A. Right-click B. Drag and drop C. Double-click List II (Result) 1. Open a file 2. Show properties 3. Move a file
71.explanation: Right-click shows options and properties, drag and drop moves a file and double-click opens it.

72.question: Match List I with List II: List I (Shortcut) A. Ctrl + V B. Ctrl + X C. Ctrl + C List II (Action) 1. Copy 2. Cut 3. Paste
72.explanation: Ctrl + C copies, Ctrl + X cuts and Ctrl + V pastes.

83.question: Match List I with List II: List I (Format) A. Italic B. Underline C. Bold List II (Shortcut) 1. Ctrl + U 2. Ctrl + B 3. Ctrl + I
83.explanation: Ctrl + I makes text italic, Ctrl + U underlines it and Ctrl + B makes it bold.

84.question: Match List I with List II: List I (Alignment) A. Justify B. Centre List II (Description) 1. Text aligned to middle 2. Even edges on both sides
84.explanation: Justified text has even edges on both sides; centred text sits in the middle.

95.question: Match List I with List II: List I (Device) A. Speaker B. Printer C. Monitor D. Keyboard E. Scanner List II (Function) 1. Outputs sound 2. Input data 3. Converts physical images to digital 4. Displays output 5. Prints documents
95.explanation: Speakers output sound, printers print documents, monitors display output, keyboards input data and scanners turn physical images into digital ones.
